title: Multiple JDK and JRE versions on one machine
answer: Yes. A machine can have multiple JDK versions installed side by side, and depending on the vendor and Java generation it may also have separate runtime/JRE installations. Each JDK contains the tools needed for development, such as `javac`, along with a runtime capable of executing Java applications. Which Java version a command uses is controlled by configuration such as PATH, JAVA_HOME, SDK managers, container/CI configuration, or the IDE's project/module SDK selection. A single Java process runs on one selected runtime at a time. In modern Java distributions, teams often install JDKs rather than separate JRE packages, so the exact packaging depends on the vendor and version. For AeroTopo, IntelliJ and Maven should consistently use the project's chosen Java 21 baseline.

steps.title: Inspect the available SDK table
steps.question: Developers often maintain older applications while evaluating newer Java releases, so multiple JDK installations can coexist on one workstation. What should an IDE SDK table make visible so you can distinguish installed Java versions from the single version selected for the current project?
steps.why: The SDK table distinguishes installed runtimes/toolchains from the version assigned to the current project.
steps.why_te: Runtime/SDK state later build behavior ni affect chestundi; concept ni environment evidence tho pair cheskunte version issues easy ga diagnose cheyyachu. SDK table installed Java homes/versions ni list cheyyagaladu. Multiple versions machine lo undavachu, kani current project ki select ayina SDK separate decision ani ee view clarify chestundi.

steps.title: Inspect AeroTopo's selected Project SDK
steps.question: Having several JDKs installed does not automatically determine which one AeroTopo should compile against. Why must IntelliJ store an explicit Project SDK so this repository can consistently use Java 21 even when Java 17 or a newer JDK is also installed?
steps.why: The installed SDK list shows machine capability while Project SDK defines the version assigned to AeroTopo.
steps.why_te: Runtime/SDK state later build behavior ni affect chestundi; concept ni environment evidence tho pair cheskunte version issues easy ga diagnose cheyyachu. Installed JDK list machine capability ni chupistundi; Project SDK project choice ni define chestundi. AeroTopo Java 21 baseline explicit ga select cheyyadam valla local environment ambiguity taggutundi.

steps.title: Open the terminal to inspect PATH selection
steps.question: Command-line Java selection can differ from the IDE because the shell resolves executables through environment configuration such as PATH or JAVA_HOME. Why should you inspect the terminal separately instead of assuming IntelliJ's Project SDK automatically controls every shell command?
steps.why: IDE and shell can select Java through different configuration mechanisms.
steps.why_te: Terminal ni separate tool laga kaakunda same project workspace lo direct verification channel laga chudandi; IDE view mariyu command-line reality okate state ni reflect chestunnaya ani compare cheyyandi. IDE SDK setting mariyu shell PATH/JAVA_HOME independent configuration paths avvachu. Anduke terminal actual ga ye executable resolve chestundo separate ga verify cheyyali.

steps.title: Check the active Java runtime
steps.question: The command confirms the runtime resolved by the current shell environment. When multiple JDKs exist, typing `java` starts whichever runtime is currently selected by the shell environment rather than all installed versions at once. What does `java --version` tell you about the specific runtime chosen for this terminal session?
steps.why: The command confirms the runtime resolved by the current shell environment.
steps.why_te: java --version result ni one-line proof laga use cheddam; idi ye assumption ni confirm chestundo identify cheste later troubleshooting easy avutundi. `java --version` current PATH/JAVA_HOME resolution dwara active ayina runtime ni chupistundi. Machine lo vere JDKs installed unna kuda current process ee selected runtime meeda start avutundi.

steps.title: Check the active Java compiler
steps.question: A JDK includes development tools such as `javac`, and its compiler version should normally align with the project's intended Java baseline. Why should `javac --version` be checked separately when multiple JDK installations could cause runtime and compiler executables to resolve differently?
steps.why: The compiler and runtime executables can be resolved from different locations on a misconfigured machine.
steps.why_te: javac --version result ni one-line proof laga use cheddam; idi ye assumption ni confirm chestundo identify cheste later troubleshooting easy avutundi. Runtime `java` mariyu compiler `javac` PATH configuration valla different installations nundi resolve avvachu. Renditini verify chesthe mixed toolchain issue mundhe identify cheyyachu. Ee step complete ayyaka "Check the active Java compiler" ni tool action laga kaakunda concept ki evidence laga mee own words lo explain cheyyagalali.

steps.title: Check which JVM Maven is using
steps.question: Maven reports the runtime it is actually using for the build process. Maven itself runs inside a Java runtime, so a terminal may show the expected `java` command while the build tool still uses a different configured Java home. Why is `mvn -version` useful when verifying a multi-JDK development machine?
steps.why: Maven reports the runtime it is actually using for the build process.
steps.why_te: mvn -version result ni one-line proof laga use cheddam; idi ye assumption ni confirm chestundo identify cheste later troubleshooting easy avutundi. `mvn -version` Maven version tho paatu build process use chestunna Java runtime ni report chestundi. Multiple JDK machine lo build tool correct Java 21 meeda undani confirm cheyyadaniki idi important.

steps.title: Verify the chosen version with the project build
steps.question: A multi-JDK machine is configured correctly only when the IDE, compiler, Maven process, and project build all agree on the intended baseline. Why should a Maven test run be the final check after verifying the separate Java installations and selections?
steps.why: The project test gate proves the separate toolchain selections cooperate correctly.
